title: CDE / ACC Project Setup Workflow
entry_conditions: The project collaboration environment is being provisioned.
Applicable folder, permission, information-state and baseline-publication requirements are known or explicitly unresolved.
Where baseline information is to enter Shared or Published, the applicable ISO 19650 transition process and responsible project parties/functions are known or explicitly unresolved.

steps.action: Create the governed folder structure required for the project.
Assign permissions and role-based access. Platform capability shall not independently assign responsibility for ISO 19650 review, approval, authorization or acceptance activities.

Configure Work in Progress, Shared, Published and Archived mappings in accordance with the S3 CDE state registry. Configure Work in Progress to Shared as the Decision A approval-for-sharing transition and Shared to Published as the Decision B authorization-and-acceptance transition.
Stage baseline information in Work in Progress or the other applicable starting state together with the required metadata and transmittal information.

Before transition from Work in Progress to Shared, verify completion and traceability of the applicable review and approval-for-sharing activity. Before transition from Shared to Published, verify completion and traceability of the applicable authorization and acceptance process, including separate lead-appointed-party authorization and appointing-party acceptance where the applicable ISO 19650-2 delivery process requires them.

Execute the permitted CDE transition and preserve traceability to the applicable review/decision evidence, responsible ISO 19650 party or project-mapped function, information scope, status/permitted use and exchange record.

Verify access, resulting information state, decision evidence and audit trail. If a required ISO 19650 responsibility or implementation mapping remains unresolved, hold the affected transition unresolved rather than substituting a platform role or supplementary TIVERIT decision.

outputs: Governed Decision A or Decision B transition, or explicitly unresolved transition
Review, decision, exchange, access and audit evidence
governance_notes: W1.2 provisions and initializes the CDE; it implements rather than redefines the ISO 19650 CDE lifecycle.
For ISO 19650-governed exchanges, Shared is reached through the applicable approval-for-sharing process and Published through the applicable authorization and acceptance process.
The CDE state records the result of the governed transition but does not replace the review and decision evidence that produced it.
Technical permission to move, upload, publish, transmit or change status in ACC is not equivalent to the project responsibility for the underlying ISO 19650 review or decision activity.
TIVERIT coordination sign-off, milestone approval and handover acceptance are supplementary governance decisions where applicable and shall not substitute for Decision A or Decision B.
This object and the S3 ACC onboarding workflow shall preserve the same ISO 19650 transition semantics.

provenance.migration_note: Source workflow W1.2 migrated from the workflow catalogue. ISO-IMP-005 re-audit aligns baseline state transitions to Decision A and Decision B semantics while preserving platform execution as implementation rather than authority.
